title: Property management changed banks
scenario: An email from your property manager says the rent collection account changed after a banking merger. It includes the building address and manager signature and asks you to update the standing order.

answers.A: Verify the new bank details with the property manager through a known phone number or tenant portal before changing payment instructions.
answers.B: Ask for the change to appear in the official tenant portal or formal lease communication.
answers.C: Make one small test transfer to the new account before moving the full rent payment.

explanation: Small test payments only prove the account receives money, not that it belongs to your landlord. Bank-detail changes require identity verification.
